statements.reason: The context links failure to develop full power with checking the system, but does not identify the M998 series or the cited manual.
statements.statement: Failure to develop full engine power is a stated reason to check the air-intake/exhaust system under standard maintenance procedures for HMMWV (M998-series) vehicles, as commonly outlined in vehicle maintenance manuals including TM 9-2320-280-20-1.

statements.reason: The stated limit is 1/8 inch (0.125 inch); 0.20 inch exceeds it.
statements.statement: A dust-unloader center opening of 0.20 inch is below the PMCS (Preventive Maintenance Control System) limit.

statements.reason: The context specifies 1/8 inch, not 0.25 inch.
statements.statement: The PMCS limit for the dust-unloader center opening is typically 0.25 inches.
A dust-unloader center opening of 0.20 inch is within acceptable limits.

statements.reason: The context says an opening exceeding 1/8 inch makes the vehicle not fully mission capable.
statements.statement: A dust-unloader center opening of 0.20 inch does not indicate a failure.
